title: Jesus, I Found My Old Prayer Journal 📔
topic: she found her two-year-old prayer journal and the still-blank pages nearly made her stop hoping

bible.text: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will perform that good thing which I have promised unto the house of Israel and to the house of Judah.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... I found my old prayer journal tonight. 📔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Two years of requests. So many pages still blank. I almost stopped hoping.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: A blank page isn't a refused prayer. Some promises carry dates you can't see yet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But what if the answer never comes? Those pages just hurt to read.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: What I promise, I perform. Hope trusts the Author isn't done writing your story.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Bring the journal back out. Not to count blanks. To see how far you've come.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What's one prayer you're still waiting to see filled?
